55918-oxford.title: Oxford
55918-oxford.creator: Unknown
55918-oxford.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Passing rapidly through London, with its roar of causes that have been won, and the suburbs, where they have no causes, and skirting the willowy Thames,--glassy or silver, or with engrailed grey waves--and brown ploughlands, elm-guarded, solitary, I approached Oxford. Nuneham woods made one great shadow on the land, one great shadow on the Thames.

arxiv-2007-14128.title: BUT-FIT at SemEval-2020 Task 5: Automatic detection of counterfactual statements with deep pre-trained language representation models
arxiv-2007-14128.creator: Martin Fajcik, Josef Jon, Martin Docekal, Pavel Smrz
arxiv-2007-14128.description: Abstract This paper describes BUT-FIT’s submission at SemEval-2020 Task 5: Modelling Causal Reasoning in Language: Detecting Counterfactuals. The challenge focused on detecting whether a given statement contains a counterfactual (Subtask 1) and extracting both antecedent and consequent parts of the counterfactual from the text (Subtask 2). We experimented with various state-of-the-art language representation models (LRMs).

arxiv-2301-08663.title: Uniqueness of the inverse conductivity problem once-differentiable complex conductivities in three dimensions
arxiv-2301-08663.creator: Ivan Pombo
arxiv-2301-08663.description: Abstract We prove uniqueness of the inverse conductivity problem in three dimensions for complex conductivities in W 1 , ∞ W^{1,\infty} . We apply quaternionic analysis to transform the inverse problem into an inverse Dirac scattering problem, as established in two dimensions by Brown and Uhlmann.

arxiv-2305-12664.title: Deep Quantum Neural Networks are Gaussian Process
arxiv-2305-12664.creator: Ali Rad Joint Center for Quantum Information and Computer Science (QuICS) Joint Quantum Institute (JQI), University of Maryland, College Park, Maryland 20742, USA rad@umd.edu
arxiv-2305-12664.description: Abstract The overparameterization of variational quantum circuits, as a model of Quantum Neural Networks (QNN), not only improves their trainability but also serves as a method for evaluating the property of a given ansatz by investigating their kernel behavior in this regime.

arxiv-2306-06961.title: Kilonovae of binary neutron star mergers leading to short-lived remnant neutron star formation 20XX Kilonovae of binary neutron star mergers leading to short-lived remnant neutron star formation – A
arxiv-2306-06961.creator: Kyohei Kawaguchi, Sho Fujibayashi, Nanae Domoto, Kenta Kiuchi, Masaru Shibata, Shinya Wanajo
arxiv-2306-06961.description: Abstract We study kilonova emission from binary neutron star (BNS) mergers for the case that a remnant massive neutron star (MNS) forms and collapses to a black hole within 20 20 ms after the onset of the merger (which we refer to as “a short-lived case") by consistently employing numerical-relativity and nucleosynthesis results.

arxiv-2404-00214.title: Ferromagnetic state with large magnetic moments realized in epitaxially strained Sr 3 Ru 2 O 7 films
arxiv-2404-00214.creator: Ren Oshima, Tatsuto Hatanaka, Shinichi Nishihaya, Takuya Nomoto, Markus Kriener, Takahiro C. Fujita, Masashi Kawasaki, Ryotaro Arita, Masaki Uchida
arxiv-2404-00214.description: Abstract Technical advancement of oxide molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) has opened new avenues for studying various quantum transport phenomena in correlated transition-metal oxides, as exemplified by the exotic superconductivity of Sr 2 RuO 4 and quantum oscillations of SrRuO 3 .

arxiv-2407-00482.title: Quantifying Spuriousness of Biased Datasets Using Partial Information Decomposition
arxiv-2407-00482.creator: Barproda Halder, Faisal Hamman, Pasan Dissanayake, Qiuyi Zhang, Ilia Sucholutsky, Sanghamitra Dutta
arxiv-2407-00482.description: Abstract Spurious patterns refer to a mathematical association between two or more variables in a dataset that are not causally related. However, this notion of spuriousness, which is usually introduced due to sampling biases in the dataset, has classically lacked a formal definition.

arxiv-2502-05074.title: Two-point deterministic equivalence for stochastic gradient dynamics in linear models
arxiv-2502-05074.creator: Alexander Atanasov, Blake Bordelon, Jacob A. Zavatone-Veth, Courtney Paquette, Cengiz Pehlevan
arxiv-2502-05074.description: Abstract We derive a novel deterministic equivalence for the two-point function of a random matrix resolvent. Using this result, we give a unified derivation of the performance of a wide variety of high-dimensional linear models trained with stochastic gradient descent. This includes high-dimensional linear regression, kernel regression, and linear random feature models.

arxiv-2509-05734.title: Non-linear cooling and control of a mechanical quantum harmonic oscillator
arxiv-2509-05734.creator: Matteo Simoni, Ivan Rojkov, Matteo Mazzanti, Wojciech Adamczyk, Alexander Ferk, Pavel Hrmo, Shreyans Jain, Tobias Sägesser, Daniel Kienzler, Jonathan Home
arxiv-2509-05734.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Matteo Simoni, Ivan Rojkov, Matteo Mazzanti, Wojciech Adamczyk, Alexander Ferk, Pavel Hrmo, Shreyans Jain, Tobias Sägesser, Daniel Kienzler, Jonathan Home. Non-linearities are a key feature allowing non-classical control of quantum harmonic oscillators. However, when non-linearities are strong, designing protocols for control is often difficult, placing a barrier to exploiting these properties fully.

arxiv-2510-21060.title: On the Sample Complexity of Differentially Private Policy Optimization
arxiv-2510-21060.creator: Yi He, Xingyu Zhou
arxiv-2510-21060.description: Abstract Policy optimization (PO) is a cornerstone of modern reinforcement learning (RL), with diverse applications spanning robotics, healthcare, and large language model training. The increasing deployment of PO in sensitive domains, however, raises significant privacy concerns. In this paper, we initiate a theoretical study of differentially private policy optimization, focusing explicitly on its sample complexity.

pmc-11432135.title: Hypothermia for Cardioprotection in Acute Coronary Syndrome Patients: From Bench to Bedside
pmc-11432135.creator: Nikolaos Pyrpyris, Kyriakos Dimitriadis, Panagiotis Iliakis, Panagiotis Theofilis, Eirini Beneki, Dimitrios Terentes-Printzios, Athanasios Sakalidis, Alexios Antonopoulos, Konstantinos Aznaouridis, Konstantinos Tsioufis, Isaac Pascual, Rebeca Lorca
pmc-11432135.description: Early revascularization for patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI) is of outmost importance in limiting infarct size and associated complications, as well as for improving long-term survival and outcomes. However, reperfusion itself may further damage the myocardium and increase the infarct size, a condition commonly recognized as myocardial reperfusion injury.

pmc-11494175.title: Comparative evaluation of data imbalance addressing techniques for CNN-based insider threat detection
pmc-11494175.creator: Taher Al-Shehari, Mohammed Kadrie, Mohammed Nasser Al-Mhiqani, Taha Alfakih, Hussain Alsalman, Mueen Uddin, Syed Sajid Ullah, Abdulhalim Dandoush
pmc-11494175.description: Insider threats pose a significant challenge in cybersecurity, demanding advanced detection methods for effective risk mitigation. This paper presents a comparative evaluation of data imbalance addressing techniques for CNN-based insider threat detection. Specifically, we integrate Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with three popular data imbalance addressing techniques: Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), Borderline-SMOTE, and Adaptive Synthetic Sampling (ADASYN).

pmc-12618066.title: ZEB1 promotes chemoimmunotherapy resistance in pancreatic cancer models by downregulating chromatin acetylation of CXCL16
pmc-12618066.creator: Shaobo Zhang, Yumeng Hu, Zhijun Zhou, Gaoyuan Lv, Chenze Zhang, Yuanyuan Guo, Fangxia Wang, Yuxin Ye, Haoran Qi, Hui Zhang, Wenming Wu, Min Li, Mingyang Liu
pmc-12618066.description: Pancreatic cancer (PC) is notoriously resistant to both chemotherapy and immunotherapy, presenting a major therapeutic challenge. Epigenetic modifications play a critical role in PC progression, yet their contribution to chemoimmunotherapy resistance remains poorly understood. Here, we identified the transcription factor ZEB1 as a critical driver of chemoimmunotherapy resistance in PC.

pmc-12697867.title: Solid Medium Droplet Microarray for Miniaturized Antimicrobial Susceptibility Test
pmc-12697867.creator: Yuliang Shao, Nikolaj K. Mandsberg, Wenxi Lei, Thomas Schwartz, Pavel A. Levkin, Anna A. Popova
pmc-12697867.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST) that is easily adaptable for point‐of‐care (POC) use is essential for addressing the growing threat of antibiotic resistance. Here, the solid medium droplet microarray (SM‐DMA), a simple yet versatile testing platform consisting of a single microscope slide patterned with an array of 80 agar droplets (6–8 μL each), containing customizable combinations of clinically relevant antibiotics, is introduced. The test allows for easy manual sample application and features a colorimetric self‐check readout.

pmc-13190747.title: KRAS and BRAF mutations modify adjuvant chemotherapy outcomes in early stage colorectal cancer
pmc-13190747.creator: Durgesh Wankhede, Mary Jose Urruchua Rodriguez, Dominic Edelmann, Matthias Kloor, Hendrik Bläker, Alexander Brobeil, Wilfried Roth, Hermann Brenner, Michael Hoffmeister
pmc-13190747.description: KRAS and BRAFV600E mutations are established biomarkers in metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC), but their predictive roles in early-stage disease remain uncertain. We aimed to determine whether KRAS and BRAFV600E mutations modify the association between adjuvant chemotherapy regimen and survival in stage III and high-risk stage II CRC.

pmc-13202309.title: From prestige to solidarity: why WHO collaborating centres must become a political force
pmc-13202309.creator: Tiago Correia, Natasha Azzopardi-Muscat
pmc-13202309.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ected institutions linked to WHO through largely vertical relationships. They must become an organized force within multilateral public health. This is not simply an institutional question. It is a political one. When universal norms are attacked and funding is suddenly withdrawn, the effects are immediate: delayed outbreak detection, weaker preparedness, more fragile access to medicines and vaccines, and further erosion of the institutions on which global health depends [1].

pmc-13273150.creator: Godwin Pius Ohemu, Howard Rodriguez-Mori, Marcelo Schmidt, Babafela Awosile

pmc-13287786.title: Dynamics of the β-cardiac myosin auto-inhibited state explain cardiomyopathy pathogenesis
pmc-13287786.creator: Daniel Auguin, Laurie Lannes, Carlos Kikuti, Nour Ayoub, Marie Juillé, Stéphane Réty, Neha Nandwani, Divya Pathak, Kathleen M Ruppel, James A Spudich, Julien Robert-Paganin, Anne Houdusse
pmc-13287786.description: Cardiac contractility requires precise regulation. A recently discovered form of regulation of cardiac contractility involves a β-cardiac myosin off-state, the Interacting-Heads Motif (CarIHM). Despite its central role in cardiac physiology and disease, CarIHM structural dynamics remain poorly understood. Here, we integrate near-atomic resolution cryo-EM with all-atom molecular dynamics to characterize CarIHM in solution and in the context of the filament.

pmc-13679822.title: Spermatic cord tunnel Penrose drainage for cephalad-tracking Fournier’s gangrene: a case report
pmc-13679822.creator: Sepideh Garrosi, Necial Marcelin, Ingrid Paredes, Marlon Pastrana
pmc-13679822.description: Fournier's gangrene tracking cephalad along spermatic cords complicates source control and soft tissue reconstruction. We describe a 61-year-old male with poorly controlled diabetes who presented with extensive scrotal necrotizing fasciitis tracking superiorly to the suprapubic region. Following wide excisional debridement, bilateral Penrose drains were passed through the spermatic cord tunnels and brought out through dependent perineal counter incisions.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Covered project The term “covered project” means a project— (A) that has been recommended in an energy assessment described in paragraph (2)(A).

uslaw-usc-t50-s3071.title: 50 U.S.C. § 3071 — National Security Agency voluntary separation
uslaw-usc-t50-s3071.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t50-s3071.description: United States Code, Title 50 (War And National Defense); Chapter 44 (National Security); Subchapter II (Miscellaneous Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Short title This section may be cited as the “National Security Agency Voluntary Separation Act”. (b) Definitions For purposes of this section— (1) the term “Director” means the Director of the National Security Agency; and (2) the term “employee”.
